name: Frigidaire Gallery® 24" Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel Full Size Built-In Dishwasher
shortDescription: This 24" dishwasher delivers a complete clean and dry with the OrbitClean™ wash system and MaxBoost™ Dry, plus a FlexSlide tray for utensils and a 1-hour wash and dry. Our sensor technology delivers better cleaning by matching performance to soil levels.

features.text: FlexSlide Upper Tray
A movable upper tray lets you maximize every inch of space, perfect for silverware, utensils, and kitchen tools
Enhanced Drying with MaxBoost™ Dry
MaxBoost™ Dry technology circulates heated air to push out moisture and pull in fresh, dry air, so you don’t have to hand dry
Premium Stainless-Steel Inner Door
Stainless Steel is durable, sleek, resists odors and stains, and is easy-to-clean
1-Hour Wash
Clean dishes in just 1 hour, perfect for busy nights or hosting, with the option to add MaxBoost™ Dry for sparkling, cabinet-ready result
Quiet as a whisper at 51 dBa
Watch TV or have a conversation, our quiet dishwasher won't disrupt your home
Status Indicator Floor Beam
Always know your dishwasher's status, floor beam shines blue when running and white when cycle is complete
Overflow Detection System
Help protect your kitchen with an overflow detection system that automatically stops water if levels get too high, preventing leaks
Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel Finish
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily
Energy Saver Cycle
Eco cycle uses less energy without compromising cleaning performance
Cleans 14 Place Settings
Cleans up to 14 place settings in one cycle
OrbitClean® Wash System
OrbitClean® wash system uses a rotating wash arm with multi-directional spray patterns for maximum coverage without using more water
Energy Star® 7.0 Certified
Certified to the latest ENERGY STAR® 7.0 water and energy consumption standards
Sanitize Option
Remove 99.9% of common household bacteria with NSF®-Certified Sanitize Option
Removable Racks
Make loading the dishwasher easier with removable racks to allow for your largest items
Stay-Put Door Allows For Easier Loading
The door stays put at whatever angle you open it for easy loading and unloading
Delay Start
Run your dishwasher on your schedule with a 2, 4, or 6 hour delay start
